purpose: Retrospective reverse search after blind turn reconstruction failed. Known synthetic answer values were supplied only after capture and after the original parser outputs were sealed.

method.scope: Exact UTF-8 and UTF-16LE values in complete WinPmem images, process user mappings from Volatility memmap, exact 64-byte context matches to saved investigator observation files, and a separate blind scan for three other bounded JSON envelope signatures. A known-value hit or observation-file match is not a blind conversation reconstruction.

b11_closed_chrome_tab.interpretation: The complete answer was absent under the two exact encodings tested. Shorter text survived outside active Chrome user mappings. This does not distinguish overwritten or unmapped application pages from a different surviving serialization or fragmented text.

b12_reloaded_chrome_tab.source_of_this_section: Original post-capture renderer maps and bounded context diagnostic. No new scan of the complete B12 image was performed for this retrospective audit.
b12_reloaded_chrome_tab.post_capture_reverse_pivot: Known pre-reload URL ID, prompt and answer were checked against image-derived renderer maps after the blind result was sealed.
b12_reloaded_chrome_tab.bounded_context_check: Available mapped bytes up to 8 KiB on either side of the first UTF-8 prompt and answer hits did not contain textTail, user, assistant, or the full saved page-observation string.
b12_reloaded_chrome_tab.boundary: The values occupied separate locations and no accepted record connected them through message IDs. This is mapped residue, not a reconstructed turn.

b13_screen_only_reloaded_chrome_tab.source_of_this_section: Original post-seal exact-value diagnostic and MemProcFS checks. No new scan of the complete B13 image was performed for this retrospective audit.
b13_screen_only_reloaded_chrome_tab.post_capture_reverse_pivot: An answer-only sentence was transcribed from the saved pre-reload screenshot after the parser output was sealed, then checked against the acquired renderer maps.
b13_screen_only_reloaded_chrome_tab.boundary: The answer sentence is not a full response, and process co-location does not establish an application-record join.

b14_one_of_two_chrome_tabs_closed.interpretation: All six exact full-answer physical hits have investigator-observation context. Four unowned physical hits match saved observation JSON around the answer byte for byte, and the two parent-mapped hits were already traced to its textTail. The open chat's bounded turn remains a positive control. These copies do not independently reconstruct the closed tab, and other encodings or record forms are outside this exact-value audit.
